verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party docs say you can point the Responses API at a remote MCP server URL, with authentication, and Groq handles all tool orchestration without you implementing tool logic. That directly delivers the ability to plug MCP servers in and use their tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that remote MCP works in practice, support for local/stdio MCP servers (only remote HTTPS is documented), and deeper documentation of tool selection and approval controls.
